findings.title: Admin member routes supply :id but controller requires :group_id
findings.body: config/routes.rb declares delete/put "members" inside resources :groups without a collection block, so the URL is /admin/groups/:id/members and the group id arrives as params[:id]. app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb add_members/remove_member do params.require(:group_id). A real request therefore raises ActionController::ParameterMissing (400) even though controller specs pass by injecting group_id directly. Fix routing or param name.

findings.title: totalPages off-by-one when count is exact multiple of limit
findings.body: totalPages is Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. For example 100 members with limit 50 yields 3 instead of 2, so the pager shows a phantom empty last page and showingLast/next logic is wrong. It should be ceil(user_count / limit).

findings.title: Next pagination can advance to empty offset == user_count
findings.body: next computes offset as Math.min(offset+limit, user_count). With user_count 100 and limit 50, from offset 50 it moves to offset 100, which is one past the last valid page (50) and returns no members. The cap should be (totalPages-1)*limit, not user_count.

findings.title: Group members endpoint allows unbounded limit and negative offset
findings.body: GroupsController#members does limit=(params[:limit]||50).to_i and offset=params[:offset].to_i with no clamping. A caller can request limit=1000000 to load the whole membership table (DoS/memory) or offset=-5/limit=0 to produce SQL errors or empty results. Clamp limit to a max (e.g. 50-200) and offset to >=0.

findings.title: add_members does not strip whitespace so comma-space lists fail
findings.body: add_members does usernames.split(",").each with User.find_by_username(username) and no strip. The user-selector produces comma-separated values that commonly contain spaces ("alice, bob"), so every username after the first fails lookup and is silently skipped, returning success with nothing added. Strip each token and skip blanks.

findings.title: remove_member bypasses Group membership logic
findings.body: remove_member does group.users.delete(user_id) then group.save. Direct association delete skips any Group#remove bookkeeping (e.g. primary_group cleanup, counters, callbacks) that the rest of the codebase uses via group.add/group.remove. Use the model removal API so state stays consistent.

findings.title: findMembers returns undefined instead of promise on empty name
findings.body: findMembers now does bare return when name is empty, previously Ember.RSVP.resolve([]). Callers such as next/previous return group.findMembers() and expect a thenable; getting undefined breaks chaining and error handling. Return a resolved promise.

findings.title: Automatic-group remove_member test uses wrong HTTP verb
findings.body: The remove_member route is DELETE per config/routes.rb, but the cannot-remove-members-from-automatic-groups example issues xhr :put. The controller test bypasses routing so it passes without exercising the real route, leaving the route/verb/param contract unverified.
